notes.title: DEVBLOG - 21/08
notes.content:
• Item icons now turn gray when the quantity is zero
• Bugfix for the magic shield
• Add credits
• Add explanations at the beginning
• Adjust ice block
• Adjust dialogue with the first boss
• Replace music for the sky phase and other remaining ones
• Item in the sky phase that keeps falling
• Improve bushes in the forest boss fight
• Fix dialogues where the character jumps at the end (still need to adjust dialogues)
• Add more regions that require specific or semi-specific powers to reach
• Check the rainbowray and dark void powers on bosses / boss power weaknesses balancing
• Coins no longer respawn (except when loading a saved game)
• Change color of the third cloud in the sky phase (background)
• Close lighthouse doors in the beach phase
• New music for the mines area
• BUGFIX: Speed magic doesn't work after loading a save, even if marked in the menu
• Magics are now not functioning in the star challenge
• BUGFIX: Bomb fire isn't killing other monsters
• BUGFIX: Missing link between ice alternative route and boss room!!!
• Add more interactive buttons to advance title/cutscenes scenes etc
• BUGFIX: WATER ERROR AGAIN when falling into a hole and returning to solid ground
• BUGFIX: item in the wrong layer in one of the casdun rooms
• Now you can't use items in the star challenge
• Inform in dialogues that now you can't use either magic or items in the star challenge!
• BUGFIX: No more dash issue (no longer infinite dash)
• Replace Double Spark with Quick Spark in the shop
• Adjust Angel Eye power movement
• New music for the sky phase
• Jump is more responsive
• BUGFIX: Credits now display completely
• Powers adjusted for the final boss
• Update control tutorial
• New sound for when enemies take damage
• Voice acting in Brazilian Portuguese!
• Now, in addition to the d-pad, the sticks also move the character!
